pages: {"text":"There is no instrument in this room. There is no reason for the needle to move."}
{"text":"I removed the marker. It was back when I returned, facing the door."}

{"text":"A mark is repeated in every hidden lower chamber: three short strokes around an empty center. The observatory notes say the central mark was copied from a room with no recorded entrance. This chamber has the same measurements."}
